description: Test suite for the MemoryStore implementation of the pluginapi in Mattermost, focusing on key-value operations, concurrency, expiration, and interface compliance.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreSet
methods.description: Unit tests for setting key-value pairs in MemoryStore, including error cases, atomic operations, expiration, and concurrency.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreSetAtomicWithRetries
methods.description: Tests for atomic set operations with retries, handling errors and race conditions.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreListKeys
methods.description: Tests for listing keys with pagination, filtering, and expiration handling.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreGet
methods.description: Tests for retrieving stored values, including byte slices and structs.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreDelete
methods.description: Test for deleting keys, including idempotency.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests for clearing all keys from the store, including idempotency.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Helper function to verify that a key is not present (nil) in the store.
